acceptanceCriteria.text: Game iframe fills full viewport height on mobile browser
Game iframe fills full viewport height in PWA mode
No unused black space below game canvas on mobile

snapshot.description: On mobile the game canvas only fills part of the screen with unused black space. PWA iframe has flex: 1 but parent has no display: flex so height is wrong. Non-PWA mobile should also use fixed positioning to fill full viewport.
snapshot.title: Fix mobile game layout: fill viewport and fix perspective

changes.newValue: Fixed PWA iframe: added display:flex+flex-direction:column to parent div and height:100% to iframe. Fixed mobile non-PWA: main element now uses position:fixed;inset:0 and container uses height:100%;display:flex. frameStyle uses height:100% instead of 100dvh.
